How it works

My approach

1

Free introductory call

A relaxed chat to see if we are a good fit.

2

First session

We explore what brings you here and what you hope for.

3

Ongoing sessions

Weekly 50-minute sessions, short or longer term.

Questions

Is it confidential?

Yes, within the usual safeguarding limits, which I explain at our first session.

How much does it cost?

£55 per 50-minute session. Concession places are available.

Can we meet online?

Yes, by secure video or telephone.

About me

Hello, I’m Alex

I am an integrative counsellor registered with the BACP, with ten years’ experience working with adults in private practice and the NHS.

I believe everyone deserves to be heard without judgement. My role is to walk alongside you while you find your own way forward.
